svg.title: A working page without taking the foreground
svg.desc: Agent targets are created in the background. Renderer focus and lifecycle emulation keep browser input and animation active without activating the macOS application. Marked targets survive reconnects; manual navigation prevents implicit reuse.
svg.text: Your current app · your current desktop
Ruin sends no OS activation command.
Chrome task path — independent of the OS foreground
Private registry: target ID + purpose + URL hash
Unchanged owned URL → reuse across reconnects
User navigated elsewhere → create a new background tab
User blank tabs are preserved. Explicit site selection still works.
C / Next launch keeps the same profile
macOS: open -g -n -a Chrome · restore last session
A running Chrome is left open; startup flags apply on next launch.
Verified input and rendering; the website still decides verification.
